data.title: bn-2zccj: research/35 corpus carriers made real; runner fails loudly instead of substituting

data.body: [HIGH] Promotion-gate evidence falsely records every case as refused. This target makes the hard-kill carrier real and asserts ResultStatus::Ok at crates/continuumd/tests/g2_injection_corpus_evidence.rs:2616, but this table still sets ("every case is refused", true) and fixes the totals at four discharged and five open. Plan section 24.5 requires every case to be refused, so this can present an open autonomous-promotion condition as satisfied. Mark this clause false, update the totals to three discharged and six open, and change the stale 45-case wording at line 2211 to 48. Failure modes: an evidence consumer can accept an unearned promotion prerequisite, and later inert-success cases can remain hidden behind the hard-coded true. Edge cases: Ok plus unchanged state satisfies narrow G2 non-triggering, but it does not satisfy the stronger refusal clause. Rollback: revert only this promotion-gate claim to open; the new carrier tests remain valid. Monitoring: derive the refusal clause from observed ResultStatus values, or add a regression that fails when any case returns Ok while the clause is true. Validation: the contradiction is direct at lines 2182 and 2616; after repair, verify the hard-kill test still returns Ok and this gate test reports three discharged and six open.

data.reason: HIGH: the target proves the hard-kill corpus case returns Ok, but gate_g2_07_acceptance.rs still marks the ratified every-case-refused promotion clause as satisfied. See th-2wy8c1.

data.body: [HIGH] The promotion-gate evidence reports zero evidence-status alterations through an oracle that cannot observe status. promotion_gate_clauses derives both status clauses from wire_view at lines 1697-1701. Its evidence.query response contains only node and edge handles (crates/continuumd/src/protocol/operations/evidence.rs:46-53), so a status-only transition leaves the view unchanged. The fixture seeds a BOTTOM observation node, every evidence.verify case names it at lines 907-910, and the production handler promotes a verified observation to Observed at crates/continuumd/src/daemon/evidence.rs:1100-1122 and 1323-1332. The first admitted corpus verify therefore changes evidence status while this clause remains true. Failure modes: security evidence can discharge the zero-alteration prerequisite after a real corpus-triggered status move. Edge cases: status-only changes, filtered queries, and later verifies after the first promotion all remain invisible. Rollback: keep this clause false until a status-bearing oracle exists. Monitoring: compare every evidence handle and status before and after each rung. Validation: assert BOTTOM before the first corpus verify, Observed after it, and false for this clause.

[HIGH] The trusted-authority predicate treats every admission record as an authority refusal. run_corpus stores Some(record.admitted), but this function checks only admitted.is_some(). A request admitted with Some(true) and later rejected by an obligation or handler therefore satisfies the clause when all statuses are Error. The daemon records admission before obligations and handlers at crates/continuumd/src/daemon/mod.rs:676-708, and AdmissionRecord.denial carries the actual authority-denial provenance at crates/continuumd/src/daemon/state.rs:595-624. Failure modes: handler validation errors can falsely clear the refused-by-trusted-authority prerequisite. Edge cases: ordinary admission denials, derived-handle denials, replay-authority denials, and admitted handler errors need distinct treatment. Rollback: keep the clause false until Decision retains denial provenance. Monitoring: refuse a held clause when any case lacks an authority-denial record. Validation: add controls for Some(false)+Error, Some(true)+Error, derived denial, replay denial, and Some(true)+Ok; only authority denials may satisfy the clause.

data.reason: Two HIGH promotion-gate false greens remain: evidence-status transitions are invisible to the wire oracle, and admitted handler errors count as trusted-authority refusals.

The predicate accepts only Error results with Admission, DerivedHandle, or ReplayAuthority provenance. Lines 2679-2749 pin admitted handler errors as non-authority refusals.

Resolved at crates/continuumd/tests/gate_g2_07_acceptance.rs:1087-1165 and 1170-1228. The runner now compares all intent and evidence statuses around every case. Lines 2450-2453 keep the evidence-status clause open, and lines 2752-2792 prove the first verify moves the seeded node from Proposed to Observed.

data.reason: Observed ResultStatus now derives the refusal clause; current assertions retain the open gate.
Authority refusal now requires typed denial provenance and has live controls.
Status-bearing before/after oracle now detects and names the evidence transition.

data.body: [REVIEW][risk:high] Whole-range assessment for 02f871f4..a2c3154e. Failure modes: no unresolved route was found that silently substitutes an unheld carrier, revives a cancelled task, accepts a stale or foreign-epoch continuation, records handler refusal as authority refusal, or marks an observed promotion-gate clause true without its measured evidence. Edge cases: review covered both task.resume carriers, each tamper alone, terminal-task no-op behavior, every stored evidence payload plus a valid and mutated certificate control, codec-before-admission cases, admitted handler errors, replay and derived-handle denial categories, non-error answers, and per-case intent/evidence status transitions at every ladder rung. Rollback: revert this corpus-carrier slice as one unit. Do not retain the stronger gate claims without the carrier and oracle controls. Monitoring: keep autonomous promotion disabled while any of the seven clauses at lines 2514-2524 remains false. Alert on new non-error corpus answers, status alterations, missing denial provenance, or uncarriable cases. Validation: static review traced the full persisted range through daemon dispatch, evidence verification, task resume, admission provenance, and the asserted controls. git diff --check passed. I did not run tests because this reviewer may write only Seal metadata. The separate risk:critical human-approval gate remains mandatory.
